alt: Jobs laid end to end on a timeline, each with a deadline marker. Adjacent pairs whose deadlines are out of order are swapped, with the pair's worst lateness before and after and the whole schedule's worst lateness. The schedule ends in earliest-deadline-first order.

steps.caption: Jobs run left to right in input order. A marker dX is job X's deadline. Jobs drawn as late miss it. The worst lateness is 4, on job C.
A (deadline 7) runs before B (deadline 4), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from 2 to -1. The whole schedule's worst is now 4.
A (deadline 7) runs before C (deadline 5), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from 4 to 2. The whole schedule's worst is now 2.
B (deadline 4) before C (deadline 5) is already in deadline order, so this pair stays.
Deadline order is B C A. Its worst lateness is 2, down from 4. No swap ever raised the worst lateness of the pair it touched.
Jobs run left to right in input order. A marker dX is job X's deadline. Jobs drawn as late miss it. The worst lateness is -1, on job A (negative means early).
A (deadline 3) before B (deadline 5) is already in deadline order, so this pair stays.
B (deadline 5) before C (deadline 9) is already in deadline order, so this pair stays.
Deadline order is A B C. Its worst lateness is -1, the same as the start. No swap ever raised the worst lateness of the pair it touched.
Jobs run left to right in input order. A marker dX is job X's deadline. Jobs drawn as late miss it. The worst lateness is 5, on job D.
A (deadline 9) runs before B (deadline 7), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from -3 to -5. The whole schedule's worst is now 5.
A (deadline 9) runs before C (deadline 5), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from 1 to -1. The whole schedule's worst is now 5.
A (deadline 9) runs before D (deadline 3), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from 5 to 3. The whole schedule's worst is now 3.
B (deadline 7) runs before C (deadline 5), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from -1 to -3. The whole schedule's worst is now 3.
B (deadline 7) runs before D (deadline 3), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from 3 to 1. The whole schedule's worst is now 1.
C (deadline 5) runs before D (deadline 3), out of order. Swapping them changes the pair's worst lateness from 1 to -1. The whole schedule's worst is now -1.
Deadline order is D C B A. Its worst lateness is -1, down from 5. No swap ever raised the worst lateness of the pair it touched.
